Dusting off this tweet from April because this gap in shared understanding of LLM capability is *widening*. It's now less "two groups of people speaking past each other" and more a sharp funnel.

sources.summary:
During the last 3 months, I spent some of my time and tokens decompiling a popular first-person shooter. The goal was not to reach a simple proof-of-concept state. Instead, we really wanted an accurate, stable and feature-complete recreation of the game.
The avid reader of my blog might have noticed that I had previously written two posts that have since been removed. Everyone else might now be wondering which game I am talking about. To both of you I can only say that corporate America was here
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用3个月、500B tokens把流行FPS准确反编译为可编译C++，并分享Claude Max与Codex Pro长期编排自主AI agents的经验。

sources.title_en: "Robot" Is a Social Construct: Why Your Dishwasher Is Not a Robot
sources.title_original: "Robot" Is a Social Construct: Why Your Dishwasher Is Not a Robot
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者花两天在工业安全标准委员会定义“robot”，反驳 Tina 称洗碗机是机器人，并追溯 Karel Čapek 1920 年戏剧 Rossum’s Universal Robots，认为“robot”不是技术功能描述，而是我们对自动化机器有某种感受的社会建构。
